activities.anchor: Something was switched on that is not the steps
activities.caption: the same eight counts — drag the divider
activities.name: danceEightCompare

config.prompt: Same eight counts of walking — drag the divider:

before.label: transit
before.text: on the beat, level focus, even weight — nothing to watch

after.label: performance
after.text: a suspension before beat three and a sudden release into it, the eyes lifting as the weight goes — it reads as hope, or escape, or ambush

config.why: Identical vocabulary; what arrived was never in the choreography.

activities.anchor: A dancer can have perfect technique and be invisible on stage
activities.caption: two achievements, two failures
activities.name: danceAchieveMatch

config.prompt: Pair each achievement with what it is:

pairs.right: executing movement accurately — what the dancer does
making it mean something — what the audience receives
class for the chassis, rehearsal for the speech

config.why: Execution alone reads as blank; expression without execution reads as muddle — neither substitutes.

activities.anchor: One more thing a beginner should know: this is an examinable discipline with a curriculum, not just an apprenticeship.
activities.caption: what the body did, or what it meant?
activities.name: danceLayersSort

config.prompt: What the body did, or what it meant? File each:

items.label: alignment, turnout, placement, line — judged against the style's grammar
sensitivity to other dancers — the group breathing as one organism

config.why: Ask both, apart, and admiration becomes understanding.

activities.anchor: Every style's aesthetic secretly encodes a physical demand, and the knowledgeable dancer trains the demand, not just the look
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the conditioning plan
activities.name: danceConditionSpot

config.prompt: One line of this conditioning plan is backwards — click it:
lines: Turnout strength means the deep hip rotators that hold rotation while moving — not just displaying it in first position.
Jumping demands elastic calf and quadriceps power — trained by jumping, in measured sets, plus strength work that protects the landings.
Contemporary floorwork demands shoulder and upper-back capacity that ballet never asks for — movers between styles retrain like athletes changing sports.
The silent landing is deceleration power; the 'hang' of a released torso is back strength.
Conditioning is unnecessary — it would add bulk and spoil the line.
config.correction: The consensus runs the other way: conditioning buys both the shape and the career length — what spoils lines is fatigue, not muscle.
config.why: The posture hides a workload — condition for the workload, not the pose.

activities.anchor: the fabled 180-degree fifth position is a rare anatomical gift
activities.caption: how much turnout is honestly available?
activities.name: danceTurnoutPlace

config.prompt: True turnout comes from the hips — how many degrees per hip does a realistic mover achieve?
config.why: Rotation lives in the hip's ball-and-socket — the femur turning in the socket; forcing it from knee and ankle twists the knee and rolls the arches inward.

activities.anchor: gaze can be held, a suspension can be rehearsed, commitment can be practised to the last count of a phrase
activities.caption: true or false — is presence a gift?
activities.name: danceExpressJudge

statements.s: Expressiveness is innate — stage presence is something you are born with.
statements.why: Focus, musicality, phrasing and projection are named because each is observable, drillable and assessable.

statements.s: A dancer looking down reads as doubt; a steady focus to the back of the theatre as command.
statements.why: Where the eyes are is where the attention is — audiences read gaze before gesture.

statements.s: The audience's eye catches the dancer who abandons a sentence of movement in its final ten percent.
statements.why: Finishing movements fully is projection's daily work.

statements.s: Dancing deliberately against the beat is a failure of musicality.
statements.why: Musicality includes dancing with the beat, on it, behind it, or against it — by choice.

activities.anchor: are part of training, not exemptions from it
activities.caption: one jump's landing, engineered in sequence
activities.name: danceLandingOrder

config.prompt: One jump's landing, engineered in sequence:
items: The impact arrives — several times body weight
Bend through ankle, knee and hip
The silent landing — deceleration spread across the joints
config.why: Adaptation happens between loads, not during them — the pause is half of the work.
